Subject: Post-discovery: lock 30min intro — availability matrix & stakeholders

Hi Priya — great chat this morning. Quick recap and next steps to lock a 30‑minute product intro that includes the technical stakeholders you mentioned.

Recap (1-sentence): Novus is evaluating inference latency and deployment isolation for a pilot; key decision factors are API latency, private deployment options, and cost/run-rate estimates.

Proposed next steps: please pick the time slot that works best for your team (two preferred, one backup). We’ll bring a compact agenda and invite the right SE.

Time options (PT):
- Option A: Tue Nov 9 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Wed Nov 10 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option C: Thu Nov 11 — 4:00–4:30 PM PT (backup)

Who to invite: you mentioned a decision owner and an infra lead — if you can confirm names/emails we’ll include them. On our side we’ll bring Neha (solutions lead) and Tessa (senior SE) for the demo.

Attachments: post-discovery-recap.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (short checklist)
Links: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min

Would you be able to confirm two preferred slots by EOD? If any of the times don’t work, tell us your availability and we’ll re-propose.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake
